texts.value: Regulatory subunit of protein phosphatase 6 (PP6). May function as a scaffolding PP6 subunit. May have an important role in maintaining immune self-tolerance

Protein phosphatase 6 (PP6) holoenzyme is proposed to be a heterotrimeric complex formed by the catalytic subunit, a SAPS domain-containing subunit (PP6R) and an ankyrin repeat-domain containing regulatory subunit (ARS). Interacts with PPP6C and ANKRD28
Expressed in skeletal muscle, placenta, heart, pancreas, testis, brain, lung, liver, kidney, spleen, thymus, prostate, small intestine, colon and leukocytes
